findings.violation: The lang attribute contains "translanguage" which is not a valid language code, making it impossible for assistive technologies to correctly determine the document language.
findings.fix: Replace lang="translanguage" with a valid language code such as lang="en" for English.

findings.evidence: <div class="icon-delete" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Delete item" id="s3-customcontrol">
findings.violation: This div with role="button" is keyboard accessible via tabindex but has no click handler or keyboard event listener, so keyboard users cannot actually activate it.
findings.fix: Add JavaScript event handlers for click and keydown events: document.getElementById('s3-customcontrol').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { /* delete action */ } });

findings.violation: The input has aria-invalid="true" but does not use aria-describedby to link to the error message, so screen readers cannot associate the error with the field.
findings.fix: Add aria-describedby attribute: <input id="promo" type="text" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="s3-form-promo-error">

findings.violation: The image has an empty alt attribute which may be intentional for decorative images, but this element is inside a button with aria-label="Delete item", creating potential redundancy or confusion.
